name: hec-color-chill-party
description: Playlist collaborative de la HEC Color & Chill Party (HEC Abidjan)

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @hcc/shared build && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "pnpm --filter @hcc/shared dev" "pnpm --filter api dev" "pnpm --filter web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @hcc/shared build && pnpm --filter web build && pnpm --filter api build
